title: Neutrophil Isolation Protocol
author: Taylor P. Johnson
materials: STEMCELL Technologies, EasySep™ Neutrophil Isolation Cocktail
Prepare isolation kit tubes and reagents in tissue culture hood:
1 x 15 mL conical tube per sample.
10% Bleach Contributed by users in waste container.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue culture hood and necessary reagents for isolation.

substeps.instruction: Clean and sanitize the tissue culture hood with 70% ethanol, wipe with Kimwipe, and UV sterilize.
Spray the phlebotomy tube, STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ Magnet, and EasySep™ Direct Human Neutrophil Isolation Kit reagents with 70% ethanol.
Vortex STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ RapidSpheres™ at high speed for 00:00:30 to mix.
Prepare a microcentrifuge tube with 10 µL Trypan Blue (diluted 1:25 in 1X PBS).
Supplement 5 mL 1x PBS with 10 µL 0.5 M EDTA per sample (final concentration 1 mM EDTA).
Label three 5 mL (12 x 75 mm) polystyrene round-bottom tubes as #1, #2, and #3.

steps.title: Prepare Whole Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Prepare the whole blood biospecimen for sampling.

substeps.instruction: Obtain whole blood drawn into ACD or EDTA phlebotomy tube.
Allow biospecimen to reach room temperature (00:30:00 post-draw) and briefly spin to remove residual blood from the top of the tube.
Carefully remove the rubber stopper and place the tube upside down in the tissue culture hood.
Gently pipette the total volume of whole blood into a labeled 50 mL conical tube using a 10 mL pipette tip to ensure uniformity.

steps.title: Initial Sample Transfer and EDTA Adjustment
steps.instruction: Transfer a specific volume of blood to tube #1 and ensure EDTA concentration is correct.

substeps.instruction: Using a mechanical pipette with a p1000 wide-bore tip, slowly transfer 998 µL of whole blood from the 50 mL conical tube to tube #1.

If the blood was not collected in an EDTA phlebotomy tube, aliquot 2 µL of 0.5 M EDTA into tube #1 and gently pipette to mix 2-3 times with the p1000 wide-bore tip to reach a final concentration of 1 mM EDTA.

steps.title: First Neutrophil Enrichment (Tube #1)
steps.instruction: Perform the first round of neutrophil isolation in tube #1.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ Neutrophil Isolation Cocktail to tube #1.
Add 50 µL STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ RapidSpheres™ to tube #1.
Gently pipette to mix 2-3 times using a p1000 wide-bore tip and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Using a 5 mL pipette tip, add 2.9 mL 1 mM EDTA in 1X PBS and pipette gently to mix (total volume 4 mL).
Place tube #1 into the STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ Magnet and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Invert the magnet containing tube #1 in one continuous motion and pour the cell suspension into tube #2. Invert completely without shaking.

steps.title: Second Neutrophil Enrichment (Tube #2)
steps.instruction: Perform the second round of neutrophil isolation in tube #2.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ RapidSpheres™ to tube #2.
Gently pipette to mix 2-3 times using a 5 mL pipette tip and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Place tube #2 into the STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ Magnet and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.

Invert the magnet containing tube #2 in one continuous motion and pour the cell suspension into tube #3, pouring along a clean area of the tube to avoid the sidewall path used in the previous transfer.

steps.title: Third Neutrophil Enrichment (Tube #3)
steps.instruction: Perform the final round of neutrophil isolation in tube #3.

substeps.instruction: Place tube #3 into the STEMCELL Technologies EasySep™ Magnet and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Invert the magnet containing tube #3 in one continuous motion and pour the cell suspension into a labeled 15 mL conical tube, avoiding the sidewall path used during the transfer from tube #2.

steps.title: Cell Recovery and Counting
steps.instruction: Harvest the enriched neutrophils and determine cell count.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant using a p1000 with a regular-bore tip and discard in a 10% bleach waste container.
Centrifuge the enriched neutrophil suspension at 300 x g for 5 minutes.
Aliquot 10 µL of the enriched neutrophil suspension into the prepared Trypan Blue microcentrifuge tube for counting.
Resuspend cells in the appropriate buffer for downstream applications according to study goals.
Record all observations and storage locations in a secure spreadsheet or LIMS database system.
